name: Sprouts bhel with paneer

steps.text: Steam the sprouts for 5 minutes for food safety and cool.
steps.cue: The sprouts are just tender, bright and still slightly crisp, and have been cooled.
steps.tip: Always cook sprouts lightly before eating. Raw sprouts carry a food-safety risk.

steps.text: Toss with paneer cubes, chopped vegetables, lemon, chilli and salt. No sweet chutney is needed.

storage: Best eaten fresh. Keep cooked sprouts and the dressed vegetables separate and combine just before eating.
